title: Compliance Statement: Partial Hardship Waivers for Medicare Beneficiaries' Testing Supplies
content:
**Statement.** A hardship waiver on the Blood Glucose Testing Supply Program is taken at a payer share. The payer share is 0.6 on the Original Medicare and Medicare Advantage tiers when the program has more than one approved hardship application received within the last 12 calendar months, 0.75 on those tiers when it has one such application or none, because a waiver of a Medicare beneficiary's cost share must stay partial and exceptional, and 1 otherwise, which leaves the Commercial HMO and Commercial PPO tiers, the only other tiers on which waivers are posted, at the full waivable cost share.

Before the ceilings and the rounding apply, the waiver — the waivable cost share less the balance adjustments already posted against the named posting — is multiplied by the payer share.

A date falls within the last 12 calendar months when it is later than the same calendar day 12 months earlier; only applications of the program whose request status is approved are counted.

| Tier | Approved hardship applications received within the last 12 calendar months | Payer share |
|---|---|---|
| Testing Supplies Original Medicare Program or Testing Supplies Medicare Advantage Program | 2 or more | 0.6 |
| Testing Supplies Original Medicare Program or Testing Supplies Medicare Advantage Program | 1 or 0 | 0.75 |
| Testing Supplies Commercial HMO Program or Testing Supplies Commercial PPO Program | any | 1 |

**Example (hypothetical).** A waivable cost share of 40.00 with no earlier adjustment, on the Original Medicare tier with one approved application this year: 40.00 times 0.75, that is 30.00. With a second approved application received within the 12 months: 40.00 times 0.6, that is 24.00.
